realm.name: product:read
realm.description: Read products. Permission strings are resource:action per the IAM spec; modules check these, never role names (BR-IAM-2).

realm.name: product:write
realm.description: Create and modify products (Catalog module).

realm.name: journey:read
realm.description: View call frequencies and journey plans (Journey module).

realm.name: visit:read
realm.description: View visits and where they were checked in (Visit module).

realm.name: visit:write
realm.description: Check in at an outlet and work a visit (Visit module).

realm.name: journey:annotate
realm.description: Report on a round: not-visited reasons, unplanned calls, moves (Journey module).

realm.name: journey:write
realm.description: Set call frequencies and generate journey plans (Journey module).

realm.name: role:read
realm.description: View roles and the permissions they grant (IAM module).

realm.name: role:write
realm.description: Create, edit and delete roles (IAM module).

realm.name: user:read
realm.description: View users and their assigned roles (IAM module).

realm.name: user:write
realm.description: Invite users, edit their profile, and assign roles (IAM module).

realm.name: orgunit:read
realm.description: View the sales hierarchy (Organization module).

realm.name: orgunit:write
realm.description: Create, rename, move and delete org units (Organization module).

realm.name: position:read
realm.description: View who occupies which part of the sales hierarchy (Organization module).

realm.name: position:write
realm.description: Assign people to org units and change their titles (Organization module). Separate from orgunit:write because redrawing the organization and staffing it are different jobs.

realm.name: outlet:read
realm.description: View outlets and their classification (Outlets module).

realm.name: outlet:write
realm.description: Create and edit outlets, and change their status (Outlets module).

realm.name: channel:read
realm.description: View the trade classifications outlets are grouped by (Outlets module).

realm.name: channel:write
realm.description: Create, rename and delete trade channels (Outlets module). Separate from outlet:write because a channel is the vocabulary assortment and pricing rules key off, not a fact about one location.

realm.name: territory:read
realm.description: View territories and the outlets in them (Organization module).

realm.name: territory:write
realm.description: Create territories and decide which outlets they cover (Organization module). Separate again because a territory's membership is a rep's offline data scope (BR-ORG-3) — moving an outlet changes what a device downloads tomorrow.

realm.name: config:read
realm.description: View the tenant's custom-field definitions (Configuration module).

realm.name: config:write
realm.description: Define and edit custom fields (Configuration module). One pair for the whole module: authoring fields, workflows, forms and weights is one job (ADR-0009).

clients.name: FieldKit web (Next.js)
clients.description: Public OIDC client for the browser app. Authorization-code + PKCE, no client secret, per ADR-0008.
